decisions.reason: This award-backed yogurt is very close to the core organic dairy range, and if it has remained in the assortment until 2022 it likely has solid enough acceptance to keep.
As a home-page flagship that fits the firm's cheese focus and brand direction, this product would normally be retained unless its sales had clearly deteriorated.
The semi-hard cheese wheel matches the firm's established cheese competence, though as a less differentiated item it is somewhat more exposed to future assortment cleanup.
The spicy cheese line still fits the cheese portfolio, but having several variants raises complexity and makes it more vulnerable to rationalisation than the stronger core items.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche remaining launch and, given the firm's narrow range and prior pruning of a related soft-cheese product, it is the best candidate to remove and free resources.
